title: Video streaming
summary: Upload, transcode and stream video to hundreds of millions of viewers.
functional: Upload a video and transcode it into several resolutions
non_functional: No re-buffering on a stable connection

watch_minutes_per_user.why: Average daily watch time per active user.

playback_mbps.why: Average delivered bitrate across devices in megabits per second.

upload_hours_per_minute.why: Hours of video uploaded every minute (the widely quoted YouTube figure).

stored_mbps_all_renditions.why: Source plus every rendition, in megabits per second of video.

cpu_seconds_per_video_second.why: Encoding all renditions costs about four CPU seconds per second of video.

peak_to_average.why: Evening peaks are about twice the daily average for video.

derived.label: New video storage per day, with replicas
